title: Prove arbitrary-count uniform tariff for the mutable-source connector
head: 5c1f39788a0fc669b7e37e27785c63e85788c350
body:
## Scope and new result

For the generic five-source common-B mutable-source connector, the minimum over **all finite correct restored Q/R/X words** at equal complete Q/R price `c>0` and source-XOR price `x>0` is

`min(72c + 4x, 74c)`.

PR1370 already proves four source XORs optimal at fixed ten queries/62 readouts, and the displayed minimum is already the minimum of known attainable bills. The new contribution is the **unrestricted-count lower bound** on this equal-price slice—not a new connector alphabet, path invention, price expression or multiplication bound. At the predecessor's abstract five-factor tariff `c=38,x=2`, the global minimum is 2744.

The proof uses even output-readout parity and paired-mask capacity to reduce every word with at most 72 map calls to the inherited fixed-count case. At 73 map calls, source/query parity forces at least two source XORs, giving the midpoint cost; all words with at least 74 map calls cost at least 74c. This covers unbounded word lengths without an expanded circuit search. An explicit 11Q/62R/2X split-edge control attains the middle face and is also optimal at `x=c/2`.

## Evidence

The self-contained written proof and exact primary verifier replay the inherited 2,600 normalized nine-point exclusion, 945-pairing obstruction, and 8,421 short source-restoration projections; the two-X multiplicity reduction checks 3,003 necessary cases. Five root witnesses and their full five-factor dirty expansions are checked in the free noncommutative module on all 37/40 arbitrary incoming rows. The complete fixture invoices are 2744, 2760, 2812, 2812 and 2778. Twenty-four primary test groups pass normally and optimized, including noncommuting-factor/heterogeneous-map/source-return/readout/scratch failures and read-only source-export controls.

A code-disjoint verifier independently checks the finite dependencies using integer Walsh autocorrelation, endpoint matchings and source-column images, and independently reconstructs all five root words. It passes 7,400 full dirty-basis executions and 240 dense matrix fixtures, plus 38 strict CLI controls across normal/optimized Python. Eight generator-side mutants now reject before stored-receipt comparison. Independent mathematical and adversarial AI reviews found no remaining concrete issue. The registered four-command replay and clean-patch replay on refreshed main both pass; exact tested hashes and limitations are in VALIDATION.md.

Reproduction on Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/mutable-source-uniform-tariff
```

## Contract, source pins and limitations

The theorem needs common exact B, temporarily writable and unobserved sources, generic correctness for every admissible exact A_m/B and dirty input, positive row length, complete restoration, and exactly the declared Q/R/elementary-X alphabet. Prices include per-call dispatch; shared fixed admission/preparation remains additional. Unequal Q/R or port-dependent prices, residual word-dependent overhead, cross-call fusion/alternative lowering and specialized maps are not covered. This is not a physical supplier or selected-construction admission, all-size outer theorem, new kappa, formal proof-assistant result, independent human review or hosted CI claim.

Started from main `410026dc5513b87db92ae98571d1d5984c69a983`; fast-forwarded before submission to `ef5f39403610d231a0c27e8a6b4f08c10209bcd6`, with all relevant guidance, catalogue, selected record, helper and pinned input bytes unchanged. Revision-2 recursive-interfaces selection seed `a5233575a2c1e99c2506293e5c2388a4` was not rerolled. TASK.json explains the complementary refinement of `connector-alphabet-change`; the [scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18912472) preceded implementation. A bounded final overlap refresh through 01:57 UTC found no same-scope claim; nearby online-delivery, second-root and coherence work has different hypotheses. No novelty guarantee is inferred from search absence.
